name: Iron Man (Infinity War)

abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Auto-Block: Şampiyonun kombo alırken bile otomatik olarak siper/blok yapmasını sağlar.
abilityDetails.Plasma: Aktifken enerji hasarı verir, blok yeterliliğini %50 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Armor Break: Düşmanın zırh korumasını kırarak hasar alımını artırır.
abilityDetails.Shock: Zamanla elektrik tabanlı şok hasarı verir.
abilityDetails.Incinerate: Zamanla enerji tabanlı yakma hasarı verir ve zırhı yok sayar.
abilityDetails.Power Gain: Güç barlarını anlık veya zamanla doldurur.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): 4 zırhla otomatik bloklar — zırhını kır veya kesin isabetli/yetenek-azaltıcı şampiyon kullan. Nötralize işe yaramaz. %15 candayken pasif çok güç kazanır, dikkat.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Deflector Protocol
Once per fight, Iron Man's Model 50 suit executes an emergency protocol if attacked while 15% Health or less remains, creating a hardened exterior by instantly granting [1 - 8] stack(s) of Molecular Armor.
While 15% Health or less remains and Iron Man has an Armor effect, gain a Power Gain Passive that is not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction and grants [3.6 - 6.6]% of Max Power per second. Additionally, Iron Man has a 100% chance to Auto-Block attacks without consuming Armor. This Auto-Block triggers Parry.

abilitySections.title: Molecular Arsenal
content: Tony Stark's Model 50 suit uses state-of-the-art nanotechnology to change form and mass at will, providing extreme adaptability and a wide array of weaponry including Blade Arm, Hammer Arm, and point-blank Repulsor attacks.

abilitySections.title: Molecular Armor Passive
content: Up to 24% chance to activate an Armor Passive when attacking or struck by an attack, increasing Armor by [3,101.06] for 8 seconds. The chance to trigger is reduced for each active Armor Passive.
Start the fight with 1 stack(s) of Molecular Armor.
Critical Resistance increases by [375] for each active Armor effect.
Each Armor effect active on Iron Man reduces the effectiveness of Power Drain, Power Steal, and Power Burn effects by 18%.
After achieving 4 stacks of any Armor effect, Iron Man has a 100% chance to Auto-Block the next attack and then consume 1 Armor effect(s). This Auto-Block triggers Parry.
A stack of Armor is lost each time Iron Man is inflicted by an Armor Break effect.
Molecular Armor provides full immunity to Bleed and Coldsnap effects while active.

abilitySections.title: Repulsor Attacks
content: The first Medium hit, the first Heavy hit, and the second and fourth Light attacks employ point-blank Repulsor blasts.
Repulsor hits don't make contact, cannot be evaded, and deal Energy Damage instead of Physical.
Repulsor hits that strike an opponent suffering from both Shock and Incinerate fuse those two Debuffs into a new Plasma Passive that has the properties of both.
Repulsor hits refresh Incinerate Debuffs and Plasma Passives on opponents.
Repulsor hits that strike an opponent suffering from a Shock or Plasma effect generate zero Power in opponents and drain up to 2.5% of their current stored Power.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: The first Repulsor hit has all the properties of a Repulsor Attack and has +[10,071] Attack Rating.
The second hit employs a Hammer Arm and has a 100% chance to inflict Armor Break on the opponent, removing one Armor Up and then reducing Armor by [916.67] for 12 seconds.
The third and final hit employs an Unblockable Blade Arm and inflicts Heal Block for 16 second(s) against targets under the effects of Regeneration.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The first hit employs an Unblockable Blade Arm and inflicts Heal Block for 16 second(s) against targets under the effects of Regeneration.
Each energy projectile has all the properties of a Repulsor attack and generates zero Power in opponents.
100% chance to leave opponents Shocked for [10,071] Energy Damage over 16 seconds.
Shock duration increases by up to 50% based on the opponents' current Power.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The first two hits are Hammer Arm Attacks. Each has a 65% chance to inflict Armor Break on the opponent, removing one Armor Up and then reducing Armor by [916.67] for 12 seconds.
The missile barrage has a 100% chance to ignite the target, inflicting Incinerate for [16,214.31] damage over 8 seconds.
If the target does not ignite, they are instead inflicted by Armor Break, removing one Armor Up and then reducing Armor by [1,833.33] for 25 seconds.
50% chance for each active Armor Break on the opponent to inflict Stun for 2.2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: 100% chance to inflict Armor Break on the opponent, removing one Armor Up and then reducing Armor by [305.56] for 3 seconds.
100% chance to instantly ignite and electrify the target, inflicting a Plasma Passive that deals [30,213] damage over 10 seconds.
The chance to inflict Plasma decreases by 20% for each Plasma effect already active on the target.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Deflector Protocol
content: Once per fight, Iron Man's Model 50 suit executes an emergency protocol if attacked while 15% Health or less remains, creating a hardened exterior by instantly granting [1 - 8] stack(s) of Molecular Armor.

While 15% Health or less remains and Iron Man has an Armor effect, gain a Power Gain Passive that is not affected by Ability Accuracy reduction and grants [3.6 - 6.6]% of Max Power per second. Additionally, Iron Man has a 100% chance to Auto-Block attacks without consuming Armor. This Auto-Block triggers Parry.
